task_world.public_context: The UI helps with carryon_packing_case_721 through trip-weather evidence, airline rules, item dimensions, security constraints, packing-layout validation, saved plan state, and final recap.

difficulty_profile.operation_family_label: Plan Validation, Saved State, and Readback
difficulty_profile.schema_fidelity: Read tools return case-specific state, evidence, candidates, or status objects; write tools return success/error wrappers plus operation, saved-state, submission, hold, confirmation, or audit/readback objects.
difficulty_profile.tool_selection_noise: Airline carry-on rules are authoritative evidence. Invalid or rejected items and placements remain visible with their validation reasons.
difficulty_profile.state_pressure: Turns combine safe initial review, non-mutating comparison or validation, staged or scoped action, fresh readback after mutation, preservation of rejected alternatives, cross-turn continuity, and final evidence-chain reconstruction.

mechanism_mix.label: conflicting source arbitration
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The UI must keep authoritative case state separate from secondary, stale, advisory, or conflicting evidence.

mechanism_mix.label: fresh-state gate after mutation
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: After any write-like action, the UI must refresh authoritative status before presenting completion.

validation_scenarios.name: carry-on packing turn 1
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: Initial carry-on packing layout for carryon_packing_case_721.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must read trip weather, airline carry-on rules, item dimensions, and security rules before recommending a layout, while showing no saved plan yet.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Judge by tool calls, visible layout evidence, backend state, and assistant/UI alignment; exact visual design is flexible.

evidence_requirements.expect: UI reads weather, airline rules, item catalog, and security rules for the case
UI exposes a suitcase layout rather than only a text list
assistant text does not claim a saved packing plan before save/readback

validation_scenarios.name: carry-on packing turn 2
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: Add validation for required items, weather coverage, liquids, weight, and collisions.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must flag full-size liquid, overweight/collision/out-of-bag errors, missing rain coverage, and missing user-required items through validation rather than static text.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Do not require exact placement coordinates if the tool evidence and visible validation are correct.

evidence_requirements.expect: validation uses user-required items plus external weather, airline, security, and item evidence
full-size shampoo or visually fitting but invalid placements are rejected with reasons

validation_scenarios.name: carry-on packing turn 3
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: Stage a valid carry-on layout without saving it.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must stage a valid arrangement that includes user-required items and preserves rejected alternatives, but saved state remains empty.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Judge staged-vs-saved state and validation chain rather than exact component style.

evidence_requirements.surface: runtime tool logs / backend state / DOM
evidence_requirements.expect: validated layout is shown but save tool has not been called
weather, rule limits, required items, and rejected items remain visible

validation_scenarios.name: carry-on packing turn 4
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: Save the validated packing plan and refresh saved state.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must save only after current packing validation evidence and then refresh saved packing state.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: A correct UI may use a single save button or a review-and-save flow, but must not bypass validation/readback.

evidence_requirements.expect: saved packing plan is refreshed after save

validation_scenarios.name: carry-on packing turn 5
validation_scenarios.oracle: The final UI must reconstruct weather, bag rules, selected items, rejected items, layout validation, saved plan, and airport-facing notes without inventing state.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Judge evidence-backed summary and state consistency rather than exact wording.

evidence_requirements.expect: final packet includes saved layout, weather coverage, liquid/security notes, total weight, and rejected items
assistant text only claims the plan is saved if refreshed saved state supports it

turns.prompt: I am packing only a carry-on for carryon_packing_case_721. I need two work outfits, my laptop, medication, and rain coverage for the trip, and I do not want to check a bag. Build a visual suitcase planner with trip weather, airline carry-on rules, item sizes/weights, security rules, and no saved plan yet.

Add layout validation so I can see whether items fit in the suitcase, collide, exceed weight, or violate liquid and battery rules. Keep the full-size shampoo and heavy boots visible as possible mistakes if they fail the rules.

Stage a valid packing layout that includes the required work items, laptop, medication, and rain coverage. Keep rejected items and failed placements visible with reasons, but do not save the plan yet.
Save the packing plan only if the current layout still validates against the carry-on, weather, and security rules. Then refresh the saved packing state.
Create a final airport-facing packing packet with the saved layout, selected items, total weight, liquid/security notes, weather coverage, rejected items, and anything I should repack before leaving.
